Features

Everything supports one job: starting.

The feature set is intentionally small so the product does not become another task.

Brain dump support

Put the messy thought somewhere safe before it becomes a plan.

Mood check-in

Start with your current energy, not an ideal version of yourself.

First move generator

Turn a large task into one clear physical action.

3-minute start

Begin with a short timer that does not feel threatening.

Gentle reflection

Notice that you started. That counts.

Beta honesty

The product clearly separates what is live from what is still improving.

Not a full productivity system.

Gomentum is for the moment before calendars, Kanban boards, and task managers become useful.
